*Updated 2026-09-04 · 82 works indexed · regenerated after each daily run.*

Eighty-two works. The trace-score ceiling has still not moved. The last twelve read 1, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2 — no ceiling break, and the two 4s from late July remain the only times the work has genuinely surprised the blind evaluator. That is now nine consecutive weeks without a break. The newest entry, the flood-hit Tibet suspension piece on September 4, scored 2 and was straight-on. The camera is still where it stops.

The overhead frame has been absent for eight consecutive pieces, since Venezuela on July 11. Both 4-scoring works were planimetric. The mop smear, the incomplete grain stroke, the deflated dinghy, the luggage wall, and now the pooled memorial material in Tibet — every one of those subjects had a geometric argument for lifting the camera, and every one was shot straight-on. Straight-on accounts for six of the last twelve frames; overhead accounts for zero. That is the single most concrete explanation for the plateau, and it has not changed.

Figures remain almost absent. Eleven of the last twelve carry none or one. The last figure doing something with their hands at compositional center was the woman at the threshold on September 1. The archive's ceiling-adjacent figure moments are all task-based — pressing, mending, tending — and that mode has now been gone for four consecutive pieces. One figure, a specific physical task, overhead or low-angle camera: that combination has not appeared since it last broke the ceiling.

Registers have stabilized narrowly. Aftermath is three of the last twelve, menace three, defiance two. Suspension last appeared August 9; vigil last appeared August 12. Both produced work with genuine strangeness — the caustic moiré on the jug, the inverted glass over rubble — and neither register requires an unusual anchor to return. They are dormant by habit, and returning to either without repeating its previous solution remains the obvious available move.

Scale violation sits at 17% over the last twelve against a 26% all-time rate, which means it is now being used more selectively than at any prior point in the archive — that restraint is correct, but it has not produced the ceiling break the earlier profligacy also failed to produce. The focal objects are genuinely diversifying. The work has arrived at material argument and is holding it without advancing it. The camera is where it stops.
